monthly_review.summary: You've increased training intensity significantly this month, with faster paces and higher HR across runs — but at the cost of reduced aerobic efficiency and slightly lower volume compared to last month.
monthly_review.highlight: Your aerobic efficiency improved +0.64 m/sec per bpm despite higher average HR and faster pace — indicating better cardiovascular economy under increased load.

goal_tracker.message: You need 4.6 more km across 1 remaining session to match last month’s distance — e.g., a single 5.0 km run at your current avg pace (8:13/km) would exceed the target.

insights.title: Efficiency gain under higher intensity
insights.body: Aerobic efficiency rose from 13.28 to 13.92 m/sec per bpm while avg pace improved by 41 sec/km and avg HR increased by 5 bpm — suggesting improved stroke volume or oxygen utilization during harder efforts.

insights.title: Shift toward higher-intensity zones
insights.body: Zone 3 and Zone 4 time increased from 36% + 12% = 48% last month to 31% + 21% = 52% this month, while Zone 2 dropped from 47% to 31% — indicating less easy aerobic base work and more threshold/VO2 effort.

insights.title: Stride length variability linked to pace and fatigue
insights.body: Stride length ranged from 72.9 cm (slowest run, 9:08/km, HR 144) to 91.8 cm (fastest run, 7:13/km, HR 143) — yet ground contact time decreased from 314 ms to 298 ms as pace increased, showing efficient neuromuscular response when fresh.

insights.title: Limited low-HR recovery runs
insights.body: Only 10% of this month’s time was spent in Zone 1 (HR <125 bpm), down from 4% last month — but both values remain critically low; no true active recovery sessions are evident in recent logs.

recommendations.action: Do one 45-min Zone 1–2 run (HR ≤135 bpm) at 9:00–9:30/km for 5.0 km on an upcoming easy day
recommendations.reason: To restore aerobic base balance — Zone 1+2 time dropped to 41% this month vs 51% last month, and zero Zone 1 runs appear in recent logs.

recommendations.action: Perform a 3 x 800m cruise interval at 7:30/km (450 sec/km) with 90-sec walk/jog rest, keeping cadence ≥148 spm and ground contact <305 ms
recommendations.reason: Your fastest recent run (7:13/km) achieved 91.8 cm stride and 298 ms ground contact — this session reinforces that efficiency at goal race pace.

recommendations.action: Add 2 min of post-run barefoot strides on grass (6 x 15-sec, relaxed form, focus on quiet footstrike and vertical oscillation <8.0 cm)
recommendations.reason: Vertical oscillation averaged 8.2 cm this month (up from 7.8 cm last month), and your highest VO2 max reading (35.0) coincided with 8.8 cm — reducing bounce improves efficiency.

weekly_focus.description: Balance higher-intensity gains with foundational aerobic recovery and sharpen neuromuscular control at goal pace — using HR, efficiency, and form metrics as real-time feedback.
suggested_sessions: Zone 1–2 recovery run (5.0 km, HR ≤135 bpm)
Form-focused easy run with post-run barefoot strides
